newsitem.title: USA: Minnesota jobless rate drops in October.
newsitem.headline: Minnesota jobless rate drops in October.

text.p: Minnesota's unemployment rate in October fell to 3.6 percent from 3.9 percent in September, the state's daprtment of economic security reported Monday.
The seasonally adjusted rate was also lower than the October 1995 jobless rate of 3.7 percent, the department said.

"This drop in the state's unemployment rate points to continued strength in the Minnesota economy," said R. Jane Brown, the department's commissioner in a news release. "This October's seasonally adjusted unemployment rate is the lowest rate for October since the state first began tracking the unemployment rate 18 years ago."
